headline: As of 2026-11-01: 55,370,215 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+8.4 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 55,370,215 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+8.4 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (7,748,573), California (6,018,065), Florida (5,289,306).
